an exact dtheta audit of the equatorial packet leakage
a degree-38 antipodally even polynomial lift of the projective Fejer filter
two normalizable full-sphere packet regions with an exact sub-per-mille leakage bound

body.current_gate: Write the fixed-P shell in its centre-of-momentum frame as k1=(M/2)(1,n), k2=(M/2)(1,-n), n in S2, and prove that the previous equal-lab-energy family is n_x=0. Recompute the N=20 azimuthal filter with dphi, homogenize every Laurent mode to F(n)=(1-n_x^2)^19 p(phi), integrate |F|^2 over dOmega=d n_x dphi, and retain the exact complement in the apparatus Hamiltonian.
body.stop_condition: Land a COEFFICIENT_COMPUTED invariant fixed-P sphere certificate, method-distinct verifier, mutation tests and report. Require exact algebraic/interval evidence for total leakage below 1/1000 and preserve the fixed-P, rotating-wave, non-gravitational and non-causal boundaries.
body.forbid: no use of dc as invariant two-body phase measure; no promotion from fixed P to energy or total-momentum bandwidth; no deletion of the residual mode; no transfer of the unequal packet result to the equal-mode relative q8 coefficient; no complete local Hamiltonian, Eq. 19, gravity, QME or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL claim
body.resource_hint: On the fixed-P sphere use n=(x,sqrt(1-x^2)cos(phi),sqrt(1-x^2)sin(phi)). For Laurent support |m|<=19, the homogeneous lift (1-x^2)^19 exp(2im phi) is the degree-38 polynomial (n_y^2+n_z^2)^(19-|m|)(n_y+sign(m)i n_z)^(2|m|). Its squared norm factorizes into an azimuthal dphi integral and the rational latitude integral of (1-x^2)^38.
